description.value: The Games Room is a dedicated sports and games bar within the multi-venue Strathcona Hotel complex in downtown Victoria, featuring 14 plasma screens, an 18-foot projector screen, pool tables, and a raised mezzanine dart hall. It is part of Vancouver Island's self-described largest pub operation and draws a lively crowd for major sporting events. Touring cyclists stopping in downtown Victoria will find solid pub fare and a full bar in a high-energy atmosphere.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack at 56m; rack at 77m; rack at 89m.
